review_evidence: README states the project models floating-point numbers, characterizes their properties, and connects the model to Lean Float via an axiomatic interface.
Direct inspection of Flean/Basic.lean found the Flean.Float inductive model, rounding semantics, normal/subnormal boundary lemmas, order preservation, and quantitative error bounds.

The nine primary Lean files are the import surface and substantive FloatCfg, representation, rounding, subnormal, integer-rounding, log-rule, and test/formalization modules; no source-local non-formal primary class was established.
summary: Retain the floating-point formalization in full.
